name: Packwiz Serve
author: admin@example.com
description: Hosts a packwiz modpack and auto-updates it from the latest GitHub release.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# packwiz serve installer
apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl jq unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# packwiz has no official release binaries, so grab the latest CI build
curl -sSL -f -o packwiz.zip "https://nightly.link/packwiz/packwiz/workflows/go/main/Linux%2064-bit%20x86.zip" || { echo "could not download packwiz"; exit 1; }
unzip -o -q packwiz.zip packwiz || { echo "could not unzip packwiz"; exit 1; }
chmod +x packwiz
rm -f packwiz.zip

# static tools, since the runtime image lacks jq and unzip
curl -sSL -f -o jq "https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/latest/download/jq-linux-amd64" || { echo "could not download jq"; exit 1; }
curl -sSL -f -o busybox "https://busybox.net/downloads/binaries/1.35.0-x86_64-linux-musl/busybox" || { echo "could not download busybox"; exit 1; }
chmod +x jq busybox

# runtime script: updater loop + packwiz serve
cat > run.sh <<'RUNEOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd /home/container
PORT="${SERVER_PORT:-8080}"
INTERVAL="${CHECK_INTERVAL:-300}"
mkdir -p pack

update() {
  local auth=()
  [[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" ]] && auth=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}")

  local rel tag url toml
  rel=$(curl -sSf "${auth[@]}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest") || { echo "[updater] could not reach github"; return 1; }

  tag=$(echo "${rel}" | ./jq -r '.tag_name')
  [[ "${tag}" == "$(cat .current_release 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0

  if [[ -n "${ASSET_PATTERN}" ]]; then
    url=$(echo "${rel}" | ./jq -r --arg p "${ASSET_PATTERN}" '[.assets[] | select(.name | test($p))][0].browser_download_url // empty')
  else
    url=$(echo "${rel}" | ./jq -r '.zipball_url // empty')
  fi
  [[ -z "${url}" ]] && { echo "[updater] no matching asset in ${tag}"; return 1; }

  echo "[updater] new release ${tag}, downloading"
  rm -rf .tmp && mkdir .tmp
  curl -sSfL "${auth[@]}" -o .tmp/pack.zip "${url}" || { echo "[updater] download failed"; rm -rf .tmp; return 1; }
  ./busybox unzip -q .tmp/pack.zip -d .tmp/x || { echo "[updater] unzip failed"; rm -rf .tmp; return 1; }

  toml=$(find .tmp/x -name pack.toml | head -n1)
  [[ -z "${toml}" ]] && { echo "[updater] no pack.toml found in ${tag}"; rm -rf .tmp; return 1; }

  # sync contents in place so the running server keeps its working directory
  find pack -mindepth 1 -delete
  cp -a "$(dirname "${toml}")/." pack/
  echo "${tag}" > .current_release
  rm -rf .tmp
  echo "[updater] now serving ${tag}"
}

update
if [[ ! -f pack/pack.toml ]]; then
  echo "[updater] no pack available, check GITHUB_REPO and ASSET_PATTERN"
  exit 1
fi

( while true; do sleep "${INTERVAL}"; update; done ) &

cd pack
echo "packwiz serve starting on port ${PORT}"
exec ../packwiz serve -p "${PORT}"
RUNEOF
chmod +x run.sh
echo "Installation process is completed!"

variables.name: Asset Pattern
variables.description: Regex for the release asset holding the pack files. Leave empty to use the release's source zip.

variables.name: GitHub Repo
variables.description: Repo to watch for releases, as owner/name.

variables.name: GitHub Token
variables.description: Optional token for private repos or higher rate limits.
